title: Inkosi Yangaphandle
author: Lumni
content:
# Inkosi Yangaphandle

Kudala, kwakunenkosi yendle eyayihlala esihlahleni esikhulu. Le nkosi yayinamandla amakhulu futhi yayihlonishwa yizo zonke izilwane.

Ngenye imini, inkosi yabona ihlwele yezinkomo eziyimpuphu zidla grass esigodini. Inkosi yaqala ukugawula umuthi omkhulu ukuze izinkomo zingadli lapho.

"Kodwa Inkosi," kwaphendula inyoka eyayilala eduze, "kungani ususe izinkomo lapho zidla khona? Izinkomo zidedela umuthi omuhle esikhundleni sayo."

Inkosi yabheka phansi. Yaqonda ukuthi inyoka ayilungile. Izinkomo zaidla igqabi elidlulile, kodwa umuthi wayo wasala ukukhula.

"Ngiyabonga, nyoka," yasho inkosi. "Ungumuntu ohlakaniphile. Anginakho ukwenza konke ngokwami."

## Amehluko

Le stori yesifiso ifundisa:

1. **Ukuhlakanipha kwabantu** — Inkosi yakwazi ukuzwa amacebiso abantu abahlakaniphile.

2. **Ukubukeka komumo** — Inkosi yaqonda ukuthi ayikwazi ukwenza konke ngokwami.

3. **Ukubonga** — Inkosi yabonga inyoka ngamacebiso ayo.
